authority_model: External scheduled experiment/referee/research network only; Math Foundry owns mathematical/runtime truth; Mastermind is PRE_REVIEW_ONLY.
runtime_priority: T0 canonical GitHub transport/control-plane calibration with two consecutive clean replay-only cohorts
E1 route/schedule truth including BASE, SBS, single-route VBS, AUTO, and best admissible same-total-budget ORACLE_SCHEDULE/portfolio
G1 one-generation fresh prospective capability gain on an objectively selected gap, before amplification
C1 generic verified-product closure/reuse when E1/early-E2 evidence justifies it
E3 executable bounded mechanism control: LEARNED_PROPOSAL vs RANDOM_ADMISSIBLE vs NO_CHANGE_EQUAL_COMPUTE
C2 bounded operator invention and unrelated-transfer CrossingEvent tests
canonical ReactionRecord/VerifiedProduct reaction-affordance graph only after actual executable runtime support
selector/ignition controller only after causal transition evidence and equal-compute controls
E5B improver-of-improver with solver F_t, memory M_t, improver I_t separated and 2x2 carryover controls
E6 independent capability admission and broader typed-contract generalization

deep_research.input_rule: Only MM06-safe and MF06-integrated research questions plus unresolved previously accepted research; never raw unverified worker questions.

transport.retry_orphan_rule: next cohort ID is derived from generation sequence plus parent-state SHA prefix; retry may adopt existing artifacts only if their parent_state_git_identity exactly equals the still-current state SHA and all contents reread/validate; otherwise use the new parent-derived ID and never overwrite the orphan
transport.worker_auth: PS-HMAC-SHA256-WORKER-PROOF-1 using per-worker 256-bit prompt-private secrets and public SHA256 commitments; MM06 independently verifies HMAC proof. This mitigates sibling-worker spoofing but does not create independent GitHub credentials or protect against a compromised verifier.

runtime_update_rule: No runtime-state change without independently validated RUNTIME_UPDATE_RECEIPT containing artifact hashes, validator results, lineage/accounting identity, before/after diagnostics, required fresh prospective evidence, and preservation/regression checks.
